comment: The class is split into one lecture day and one lab day to work on the weekly lab assignment. Lectures aren't all that interesting but labs are very straight forward and instructions are very helpful. He is readily available to help during the lab and is super flexible about due dates. Weekly lab assignments, 2 tests, and 2 projects. Easy grader
Very nice and easy to talk to for questions.

Super chill and funny, he definitely loves teaching and wants you to do well and have fun in the class. Lots of extra credit opportunities. You have 10 labs, a midterm, a final, and a group project. Tests are pretty straightforward, and he is easy-going on the labs, especially if you just ask for help; he wants to help you. Take this class!!

Kyle is the best. He's so funny and chill and genuinely wants everyone to do well in this class. He gives sooo many opportunities for extra credit, exam review, flexible due dates, etc. that it's really on you if you don't do well in this class. He genuinely just wants people to learn and have fun with maps. Fantastic guy.
Great teacher, fun class, engaging curriculum. Occasionally hit-or-miss with the grading, but definitely recommend taking his class.
good professor
Hilarious Professor, chill class atmosphere, one of my all-time favorite courses at UR!

Kyle is the best professor. He is so kind and accommodating to students needs, and genuinely wants you to exceed. He offers a ton of extra credit, and is so helpful to students who struggle or are new to GIS. There were a lot of moments that I felt like I was asking stupid questions, but he always helped me and was caring and very responsive.
goated/goated
Love his classes. Great professor who cares deeply about his students

One of the best, most in-touch professors at UR. Beyond being hilarious, he makes learning GIS very easy and guides students through increasingly complex tasks in a straightforward way by continuously building on previously-learned material. Many opportunities to earn a good grade. Only complaint is fast lectures & sometimes lacking clarity

I loved this class and found the actual content super interesting, but the lectures before the labs were boring and hard to follow. The labs were cool and helped me learn the content a lot more than the lectures. GIS is a great skill and this class is an easy A. Kyle is funny but gets off topic really easily.

Absolutely goated. Wish I could take more classes with Kyle (I'm not a geog major or minor). You learn a lot but he makes it fun and manageable if you are taking lots of other courses. He takes time to help you outside of class and is super accessible and knowledgeable.

Kyle is awesome! Super funny in an awkward sort of way but I loved his class. The labs have all the instructions needed to make the maps & there are only two exams which are not too difficult. There is one individual project that is extremely easy and a group project which is not a lot of work. Overall, interesting class & I learned new skills!

Kyle is the best! He is the type of professor that changes your life. He is funny, understanding, intelligent, and passionate about his work. The course is like no other at UR and you learn so much! He really cares about his students and their success. 1000000/10 would recommend!

Excellent! Kyle is very good at teaching the subject. He is always avaliable outside of class and would respond to our messages within minutes. He structures the class very well with labs and lectures alternating every class. At a personal level he is also very nice and caring. 

His class is not very hard. Do your labs and you will be fine

Professor Kyle was great. He was funny, caring and made lectures interesting. The workload was manageable and he gave incredibly clear instructions. The tests reflected the material learned in class and the lab projects were cool.

I don't even go to this school but I had Professor Redican my freshman year at MSU and just wanted to leave a review and vouch for how awesome he is. He is super funny and will help you any way he cannot to mention the fact that he is an amazing professor as well. One of my favorite professors I have ever had.

Literally one of the best professors ever. One day you learn, one day you work on labs. One lab a week, takes time but his instructions are clear and you learn as you go. He is the most hilarious and real professor you will ever have. He is always willing to help you out and always replies quickly. Makes everything fun but you learn SO MUCH.

I loved Kyle's class. He's really funny and transparent, and is easy to ask for help from. He made learning a new computer program easy. Lectures one day of the week, and a lab the other day. The grading structure is very straightforward: Graded on labs, 2 projects, and 3 exams. Study the slides and complete the labs, and you will get a good grade.
